d:
The Suns defeated the Rockets, 102-99 tonight in Phoenix. Devin Booker finished with a team-high 24 points along with 3 steals and 3 assists for the Suns, while Jalen Green tallied 16 points, 6 assists and 3 rebounds in the game. Kevin Durant recorded 21 points, 10 rebounds and 3 assists. The Suns improve their record to 3-5 with the win, while the Rockets fall to 7-3 for the season.
